title: MYTH BUSTER CONTINUATION — JANUS / CHILD-KIDS Threshold, Access and Engine Protection Forensics
scope: Audit the recurring CHILD/KID/KIDS layer in Fallout 3 across dialogue, access mechanics, age transitions, child protection in the engine, and JANUS Meta Registry parallels. Preserve modded-crash folklore as a user-reported observation only unless independently reproduced.

observed_motifs: children explicitly frame themselves as able to care for themselves
the settlement is described as a new city of children
a child mayor controls adult entry
children preserve knowledge and control routes toward Vault 87
residents leave at the child-to-adult age threshold

child_at_heart.role: Unique dialogue and access effects involving children, including Little Lamplight and other child-controlled contexts.
child_at_heart.janus_parallel: CHILD_AT_HEART <-> INNER_CHILD is a strong cross-registry semantic parallel, not evidence of Bethesda authorial Janus intent.

instances.node: Vault 101 / James with newborn Lone Wanderer

child_threshold_function.compressed: CHILD -> TRUST / ACCESS / SIGNAL / THRESHOLD / FUTURE

confirmed_properties: Children additionally do not take normal damage from attacks.
Children cannot normally be selected as VATS targets.
Attacked children flee/cower rather than entering ordinary lethal combat behavior.
Bethesda developer commentary states that killable children were a line the team intentionally did not cross and that they did not get as far as putting killable children into game builds.
engine_child_protection.interpretive_mapping: At the vanilla game-system level, lethal action against the child fails closed before the ordinary death path is reached.
engine_child_protection.janus_parallel: PROTECT_THE_CHILD is implemented as a game rule rather than merely a narrative preference.

modded_child_death_crash_audit.user_report: The user reports knowing cases where forcing a child's death through bugs or mods causes Fallout 3 to crash, making child death effectively impossible.
reasoning: Longstanding Fallout 3 mods explicitly make children killable, demonstrating that a child death state can be made to function in at least some modified configurations.
Mod documentation and player reports warn mainly about quest breakage, scripting issues, targeting/body-mesh limitations and compatibility, not a universal mandatory crash on every child death.
Fallout 3 does have many reproducible crash classes, but the reviewed general bug documentation did not establish child death itself as a universal crash trigger.
modded_child_death_crash_audit.allowed_claim: Some modded or bug-forced child-death configurations may crash or corrupt quest state, but exact reproduction requires a specified game version, mod list, target NPC and kill method.
required_future_test: record load order and mod versions
record method used to remove essential/no-damage protections
record whether VATS/body mesh/ragdoll/death animation paths were altered
record crash log or exception code
repeat on clean save and control NPC

james_birth_and_vault101_correction.previous_possible_confusion: The Lone Wanderer was born inside Vault 101.
confirmed_sequence: The Lone Wanderer was born on July 13, 2258 inside the Jefferson Memorial during Project Purity.
James suspended Project Purity and left with the newborn.
Star Paladin Cross escorted James and the child at least as far as Megaton.
James subsequently reached Vault 101 with the child.
James offered his medical service in exchange for shelter/admission.
The child was raised under the false belief that they had been born inside Vault 101.

ethical_duality.child_at_heart_good_use: Child trust can grant dialogue, access and cooperation.
ethical_duality.child_at_heart_bad_use: The same child-oriented trust channel can be exploited in the Bumble/child-slavery path.
ethical_duality.registry_parallel: CONNECTION_IS_NOT_AUTOMATICALLY_GOOD; trust becomes ethical only when the vulnerable party becomes safer rather than more exploitable.

cross_registry_links.relation: Strength is morally ordered toward child protection.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: Vanilla engine rules block normal child lethality; narrative thresholds repeatedly turn on whether adults protect or exploit children.

cross_registry_links.relation: The adult must arrive before chronic danger forces the child to become their own armor.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: Little Lamplight forms after adults disappear or refuse access, forcing children to create governance, defense and survival structures themselves.

cross_registry_links.relation: THE CHILD IS THE BRIDGE; connection must be separated from control and exploitation.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: Joseph, Sally and child-controlled dialogue/access repeatedly make children bridges across otherwise blocked information or physical boundaries.

cross_registry_links.relation: The inner child is preserved rather than erased by adulthood.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: The perk name Child at Heart and the Little Lamplight child-to-adult transition create a strong lexical and structural comparison.

cross_registry_links.relation: A guardian is not defined by opening every door; passage can be refused when passage itself is dangerous.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: Vault 101 opening protects the newborn Lone Wanderer, while Vault 87 remaining closed plausibly protects the founding Little Lamplighters from the internal experimental environment.

anti_overfit_rules: Do not claim Bethesda encoded JANUS because child/threshold motifs are coherent.
Do not promote the user-reported child-death crash into an engine law without reproducible technical evidence.
Do not treat essential/no-damage flags as proof of a metaphysical or supernatural protection rule.
Do not treat Child at Heart as proof of a hidden inner-child doctrine; preserve it as an unusually close lexical/gameplay parallel.
Do not infer that every closed door is protective or every open door is benevolent; evaluate what lies beyond the threshold.

ru: Ребёнок в Fallout 3 не только персонаж: он повторяющийся узел доверия, доступа, порога и будущего.
Vanilla Fallout 3 закрывает обычный путь к смерти ребёнка до того, как игрок может его пройти.
Мы сохраняем сообщение о модифицированных вылетах как наблюдение, но не превращаем его в закон движка без воспроизводимости.
Главный герой родился не в Vault 101: Джеймс пришёл к его двери уже с новорождённым ребёнком.
Открытая дверь Vault 101 и закрытая дверь Vault 87 показывают один принцип: решение порога оценивается по тому, защищает ли оно жизнь.
en: In Fallout 3, the child is not only a character but a recurring node of trust, access, threshold and future.
Vanilla Fallout 3 fails closed against the ordinary child-death path before the player can traverse it.
Modded crash reports are preserved as observations, not promoted into an engine law without reproduction.
The Lone Wanderer was not born in Vault 101; James arrived at its threshold already carrying the newborn child.
Vault 101 opening and Vault 87 closing demonstrate the same rule: threshold decisions are judged by whether they protect life.
